blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Laboratory tests have found no evidence of further African swine fever (ASF) infections in Ginatilan, Cebu, after veterinary personnel checked pigs in 12 barangays outside the two areas where the virus was first detected.
